description:
Overview

A Gabriel é uma startup de tecnologia, comprometida em resolver um dos maiores problemas do Brasil: a segurança das pessoas. Instalamos câmeras inteligentes e interconectadas, voltadas para a rua, a partir de condomínios, casas e comércios. Nossa infraestrutura é capaz de entender dinâmicas criminais completas e proteger bairros inteiros. Com atuação em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, a Gabriel tem a missão de construir a maior rede de câmeras do país e servir segurança em qualquer lugar a todos os nossos clientes.

O desafio é gigante. Por aqui, colocamos a mão na massa! Você terá oportunidades de aprendizado e enfrentará grandes desafios técnicos e de escala, junto com times multidisciplinares e altamente capacitados.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

  • Trabalhe com um propósito real: ajude a tornar os bairros mais seguros e protegidos;
  • Crescimento profissional com aprendizado contínuo e novas oportunidades;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e focado em resultados;
  • Faça parte da expansão da Gabriel e aumente nossa rede de proteção.

Sua missão começa no centro do Rio de Janeiro, em uma região onde você será uma peça-chave na expansão da Gabriel, levando segurança e inovação para cada bairro;

Responsabilidades

  • Prospectar novos clientes na sua área de atuação, traçando planos estratégicos de visitas para acompanhamento e prospecção externa, identificando oportunidades e conectando mais pessoas à nossa rede de proteção;
  • Participar das matinais comerciais, alinhando estratégias com o coordenador, recebendo treinamentos, trocando aprendizados com o time, acompanhando resultados e celebrando conquistas;
  • Conduzir visitas comerciais para apresentar nossos produtos, elaborar propostas sob medida e realizar negociações de acordo com os critérios vigentes;
  • Contribuir para a expansão da Gabriel, levando segurança e inovação para cada bairro;
  • Mostrar como a Gabriel pode devolver às ruas o direito de serem seguras para todos;
  • Trabalhar de rua em rua, de bairro em bairro, promovendo a solução da Gabriel e ampliando a presença da empresa.

No fim do dia, a satisfação de estar se desafiando e saber que seu trabalho está mudando vidas, expandindo nossa presença e construindo um futuro mais seguro para todos.

O que esperamos de você

  • Compromisso com resultados e vontade de fazer a diferença;
  • Gostar de vendas e ter excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, sempre com empatia;
  • Boa fluência tecnológica, sabendo explicar conceitos técnicos para os clientes;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a novos desafios e oportunidades;
  • Proatividade, iniciativa e disposição para aprender e crescer em um ambiente em constante mudança;
  • Trabalho em equipe e comunicação clara, essenciais para o nosso sucesso coletivo;
  • Sangue nos olhos: nossa meta é agressiva e iremos batê-la juntos!

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com startups;
  • Experiência com vendas B2B;
  • Experiência com vendas para prédios (relacionamento com síndicos) ou tecnologia de segurança (CFTV, alarmes);
  • Conhecimento do CRM HubSpot;
  • Experiência com trabalho externo.

Benefícios

  • Vale-Refeição: R$ 41,91 por dia trabalhado (benefício no cartão Caju);
  • Vale-transporte/Mobilidade: valor gasto para chegar ao trabalho usando transporte público sem desconto no salário (pago no cartão Caju);
  • Plano de Saúde: Alice, cobertura nacional e acesso a hospitais renomados;
  • Plano odontológico: Odontoprev, sem coparticipação para você e seus dependentes;
  • Auxílio Saúde Física: TotalPass Plano TP+1 custeado pela empresa;
  • Auxílio Saúde Mental: Reembolso de até R$ 100,00 por sessão de psicoterapia;
  • Auxílio Educação: reembolso de 50% do gasto em educação até teto de R$ 4.000/ano;
  • Auxílio Creche: valores conforme faixa etária (até 2 anos R$676,81; de 2 a 5 anos R$592,21).

Modelo de Contratação

  • Contratação CLT;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Localização: Rio de Janeiro - RJ

A Gabriel é uma startup de tecnologia com um grande propósito: devolver o direito às ruas para todos os brasileiros e brasileiras. Como? Desenvolvendo tecnologia 100% nacional para criar cidades mais inteligentes, seguras e justas. Acreditamos que segurança é um direito de todos, e estamos aqui para tornar isso realidade!

Instalamos câmeras inteligentes interconectadas, voltadas para a rua, a partir de condomínios, casas e comércios. Com nossa infraestrutura, conseguimos gerar inteligência e dados para prevenir crimes, trazendo mais tranquilidade para os bairros e comunidades.

Agora, estamos prontos para expandir ainda mais e queremos você conosco para fazer isso acontecer!

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures safely and effectively, and be able to explain all aspects of the products and services to guests. They must have excellent communication skills and provide aesthetic medical solutions to address guests’ concerns. The Medi-Spa Physicians work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist with sales, marketing, and promotions and translate when necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain knowledge of spa services and products to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi-Spa Sales Consultant.

Position requirements – Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to guests; work closely with the Medi-Spa Sales Consultant; must have enthusiasm and excellent customer service skills; able to give effective presentations related to medi-spa services; enjoy working with people; possess friendly and outgoing personality; excellent communication and listening skills; basic computer knowledge; must be a team player.

Responsibilities

  • Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.
  • Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi-spa protocols.
  • Conduct patient follow-up as required.
  • Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.
  • Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control.
  • Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.
  • Complete with the guest the Medical Record prior to services; medical records are stored per policy for the required period (2 years, or 3 years on Cunard and P&O).
  • Cross-promote other spa services.
  • Uphold sanitation and sterilization standards as directed; clean and restock treatment rooms as required.
  • Manage medical product and supply inventory.
  • Communicate any occurrences involving staff or guests to management.
  • Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously; provide accurate, immediate responses as requested.
  • Maintain a positive work environment and participate in training and staff meetings.
  • Attend required team meetings on embarkation day and sea days.
  • Assist in all areas of spa operation as directed by management.
  • Train new spa staff in medi-spa services and cross-promotion skills and follow up to ensure confidence.
  • Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies and complete daily/email reports as required.

Qualifications

  • Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.
  • Hold a current valid medical license.
  • Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.
  • Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.
  • Fluency in English.

Notes

Seniority level: Entry level

Employment type: Full-time

title: Mecânico de Manutenção - (Máquinas pesadas)
description:
Overview

Mecânico de Manutenção - (Máquinas pesadas) – Descrição do papel: o Mecânico de Manutenção de Equipamentos Pesados será um profissional chave na equipe, responsável por assegurar a plena operacionalidade e segurança de uma vasta gama de máquinas. Este profissional realizará diagnósticos e reparos em sistemas elétricos, de refrigeração e mecânica hidráulica, atuando na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de Guindastes LIEBHERR e FUWA, Empilhadeiras HYUNDAI e HYSTER, e equipamentos da Linha Amarela, incluindo máquinas Volvo e Caterpillar. Será essencial a leitura e interpretação de diagramas para identificação e resolução de falhas, bem como a substituição precisa de peças e componentes. O(a) Mecânico(a) deverá assegurar a conformidade das manutenções com as normas de segurança (como NBR 15965), gerenciar e priorizar tarefas sob prazos, lidar dinamicamente com múltiplas demandas, aplicar senso crítico e de urgência na resolução de problemas e manter atenção rigorosa aos detalhes em todas as etapas, além de preencher relatórios de serviço e registros de manutenção de forma precisa e organizada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e defeitos mecânicos em sistemas diversos.
  • Fazer ajustes e regulagens em componentes mecânicos.
  • Monitorar o funcionamento de máquinas, identificando a necessidade de reparos.
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades de manutenção realizadas.
  • Colaborar na montagem e desmonte de equipamentos, conforme necessário.
  • Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos.
  • Acompanhar a manutenção de registros e documentação técnica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Amplo conhecimento em elétrica para manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de refrigeração.
  • Conhecimento Mecânico Hidráulico.
  • Leitura de diagramas e identificação de falhas.
  • Conhecimento em Empilhadeiras e Guindastes (incluindo modelos LIEBHERR, FUWA, HYUNDAI, HYSTER).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em manutenção de equipamentos da Linha Amarela (Volvo e Caterpillar).
  • Conhecimento da norma NBR 15965 (conforme relevância para o escopo da empresa).

Main responsibilities

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar queries altamente complexas em SQL Server, garantindo máxima performance e escalabilidade;

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar jobs e schedulers para rotinas críticas de processamento em lote;

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e infraestrutura para garantir integração eficiente entre aplicações e bancos de dados.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência avançada e comprovada com SQL Server em ambientes de missão crítica;
  • Domínio de T-SQL e técnicas de otimização de código para alta performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados relacional, normalização e práticas de governança de dados;
  • Experiência consistente na criação e otimização de stored procedures, functions, triggers e views complexas;
  • Expertise em tuning de performance, índices, particionamento e análise de gargalos de acesso a dados;
  • Vivência com ETL, processamento massivo e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento profundo de segurança de banco de dados, controle de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de transações e concorrência, aplicando padrões para alta disponibilidade;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de desempenho;
  • Experiência com versionamento de scripts (Git, SVN, etc.).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Azure SQL Database ou outras plataformas de nuvem;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, SSIS, SSRS e integração com soluções analíticas;
  • Experiência com NoSQL, Big Data e Data Warehouse;
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. The Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients, collaborating with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management and Fund administration.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. You will be one of the key contributors improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions in a challenging product area.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade features for the Unified Experience for PE.
  • Build and shape front-end and/or full-stack solutions using ReactJS, TypeScript, and related tooling.
  • Champion scalable architectures, SOA/microservices concepts, and data-driven approaches to improve user experience for Private Equity clients.
  • Engage with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing to deliver customer value and refine requirements.

About You

  • You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:
  • 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • Experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • Passion for elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, TypeScript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • Interest in AI/ML technologies and how they can improve product experiences.
  • A desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to own your work end-to-end.
  • Willingness to move fast while building for the future.

Disclosures

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Partner Manager to join our Business Development organization to cover partners across the Brazil Market. This role is responsible for supporting Elastic’s efforts to build an elite ecosystem of partners who are highly strategic to the company’s long-term goals.

The Partner Manager will recruit, enable, and support a network of partners in order to drive partner sourced, influenced, and fulfilled revenue. We want energetic, innovative, and results-oriented partner leaders.

  • Negotiate and close channel and partnership contracts
  • Create and drive overall channel strategy and prioritization plan for coverage area, including the development of an Elastic Stack practice across priority channel partners

What You Bring Along

  • Energetic, smart, self-directed, and passionate business development and channels professional

    • Demonstrate knowledge and awareness of potential emergency scenarios.
    • Contribute to the effective de-brief and analysis of exercises.
  • 4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
    • Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
    • Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
    • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
    • Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  • 5) Emergency Response
    • Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
    • Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

description:
Overview


Statkraft is a leading company in hydropower internationally and Europe’s largest generator of renewable energy. The Group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power and supplies district heating. Statkraft is a global company in energy market operations. Statkraft has 3500 employees in 15 countries.


The main activities of the Business Area Market Operations & IT are energy management for Statkraft’s assets, trading & origination and market access services in Europe, South America and India. In addition, the business area contains local business support, finance & risk support, and IT services. In M there are 750 employees. The market operations of Statkraft are performed in the offices of Amsterdam, Düsseldorf, Stockholm, Istanbul, London, New Delhi, Oslo, Rio de Janeiro and Trondheim.


Your team:


The Finance and Risk operations of Statkraft Markets Brazil is performed in Rio de Janeiro and Florianapolis. This role will be located in Rio de Janeiro.



  • Extremely qualified professionals with excellent knowledge and careers in energy and financial markets

  • Offices located in Rio de Janeiro and in Florianópolis focused on:

  • Power Trading and Origination

  • Business Development and Structuring


Your role as Senior Risk Analyst


Responsible for developing, controlling and reporting Profit / Loss (P / L), market and credit risk metrics, risk methodologies and mitigation strategies. Provide support and guidance to help front office structure their activities towards market and credit risk. Analyze new products and structures. Ensure that all operations are carried out within the established risk limits and that business results are reported accurately.


Main Activities



  • Develop, operate and maintain risk models for Trading & Origination;

  • Monitor and report risk metrics and risk capital allocation/usage of the trading books, ensuring that the total amounts are within the mandates;

  • Review trading related transactions and support front office to measure the impact of new operations on risk metrics, simulating and calculating the impact on Value at Risk (VaR), Profit at Risk (PaR) and credit risk measures;

  • Evaluate and control the credit risk of the counterparties, following the company\'s credit risk policy;

  • Control and report the business financial performance represented by the Profit/Loss (P/L) metrics, through analysis of spreadsheets/systems, ensuring that all input data (data from the energy purchase and sale agreements, inflation, fx and interest curve) are correctly captured and updated;

  • Cooperate with colleagues across departments in Brazil and in Oslo.


Your profile


Graduation: Physics, Engineering, Mathemathics, Quantitative Economics or another quantitative study.


Solid Experience in the risk analysis area.


Language: Advanced English


Statistics and Econometric


Advanced Excel and Programming Skills (python, R)


Knowledge of the Brazilian energy market


Analysis of Financial Statements

Carta’s platform supports 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries and provides tools to build, invest, and scale with confidence. The Problems You'll Solve

The Unified Experience for PE team creates a unified, user-friendly experience for investors, including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

description:

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. Nossa cultura celebra pensadores independentes e realizadores que impactam positivamente nossos clientes e moldam nossa indústria. A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de logística, mineração, energia e O&G. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Como você irá contribuir

  • Liderar a execução de frentes de trabalho com propriedade, identificando iniciativas de melhoria, desempenhando papel ativo em todos os aspectos de envolvimento com o cliente;
  • Liderar reuniões e apresentações junto ao nível gerencial e executivo do cliente e da A&M, transmitindo segurança e domínio dos temas abordados;
  • Responder prontamente às demandas do projeto e antecipar ações críticas para o sucesso das iniciativas;
  • Atuação em diversos projetos e trabalho com vários colegas e clientes em uma variedade de setores e áreas funcionais;
  • Viabilizar articulações efetivas entre lideranças, conquistando alinhamentos e produzindo resultados que atendem aos interesses dos envolvidos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da prática apoiando o desenvolvimento de produto e/ou indústria;
  • Desenvolver a conta que estiver atuando, identificando oportunidades e trabalhando em conjunto com a liderança para transformar em negócios;
  • Ser elo de conexão entre staff e liderança para disseminação de cultura e gestão de questões;
  • Coordenar e garantir adequações às questões administrativas (programação, planilha de vendas, collections, etc.).

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos complexos em ambiente multicultural e corporativo nos setores de mineração e Óleo & Gás, seja em consultorias ou indústrias;
  • Pós-graduação em gestão de projetos e/ou administração ou finanças será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento robusto dos produtos de I&CP;
  • Ao menos uma certificação em gestão de projetos de entidades preconizadas (ex: AACE, PMI, etc);
  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Inglês avançado.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu eu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. About Elfie

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal is to become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform across all therapeutic areas. We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025. Try Elfie for yourself by downloading it on the App Store or Google Play.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Elfie, you’ll be at the forefront of shaping how our vision translates into meaningful user and business outcomes. You’ll own end-to-end product experiences, from identifying user needs to defining workflows and shaping solutions that drive real impact in healthcare. You will collaborate closely with founders, engineers, and data teams to ship features that are intuitive, scalable, and strategically aligned. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on solving complex problems with clarity, care, and craft.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract – With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare – From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup – Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework – Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • 14 Days PTO + Public Holidays – Real time off
  • Hybrid Working – 3 days in the office per week
  • Refreshments – Free Lunch and Dinner every day for you to enjoy

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with founders and the product team to understand business goals, product vision, and service objectives.
  • Translate ideas into clear, actionable design documentation that supports both product specification and engineering implementation.
  • Research, design, and shape end-to-end product experiences for users across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Map out user journeys, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs to explore and communicate design solutions throughout the iterative process.
  • Produce prototypes, visual assets, and interface components to support testing and development.
  • Continuously refine and enhance the product experience based on user insights and feedback.

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a UI/UX or product design role, with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end mobile app design.
  • Proficient in Figma (required), with additional experience in tools like Adobe Suite considered a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects across fast-paced environments with strong planning, time management, and stakeholder alignment skills.
  • Fluent in English, with clear communication and documentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience in product development is a bonus, especially in software or tech-focused environments.
  • Proactive, self-motivated mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to dive into details to meet goals.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and adapting designs in an iterative, fast-changing product cycle.
  • Solid foundation in visual design, including drawing, color theory, and layout.
  • Portfolio highlights strong visual craft and ability to solve complex interaction problems.
  • Awareness of current trends in mobile UX/UI and game-inspired interfaces. Bonus points for proficiency in Lottie, Rive, or other motion tools.

Why Join Elfie

We’re a global start-up that is mission-led and fiercely product-driven. We’re building something that improves lives with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

What Now?

Apply today for immediate consideration. If you know someone who would be a good fit, we offer a referral reward if your recommendation is hired. Contact Talent Acquisition for more information.

Neste desafio você utilizará a disciplina técnica de arquitetura e repertório para antecipar cenários, avaliar riscos e impactos, e assegurar que todos os projetos estejam alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos do aeroporto, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória e otimização de recursos em um ambiente de alta complexidade e dinamismo, se mantendo atualizado às tendências e tecnologias existentes no mercado da arquitetura e aviação.

  • Realizar interface com stakeholders para definir e elaborar o programa de necessidades de cada escopo, garantindo alinhamento desde o início do projeto;

  • Desenvolver escopos detalhados, com foco em arquitetura e áreas relacionadas, apresentando clareza e domínio das necessidades a serem contratadas;

  • Fornecer direcionamento técnico ao projeto do início ao fim, atendendo aos prazos, às premissas estabelecidas, realizando vistorias de qualidade e avaliando fornecedores;

  • Conduzir avaliações pós-implementação, identificando lições aprendidas e promovendo melhorias contínuas nos processos de gestão de Capex.

A Yduqs é grupo de serviços em educação e tecnologia e temos o objetivo de promover um salto de qualidade para o ensino superior no Brasil. Oferecemos educação de qualidade para pessoas de todas as classes sociais, em todo o país, e ao longo de toda a sua vida adulta.

Com cerca de 1,4 milhão de alunos, somos um dos maiores grupos de educação superior no Brasil.

Com quase 16 mil colaboradores, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no país, de acordo com o Prêmio EXAME em Gestão de Pessoas 2024.

Somos embaixadores do Educa2030, movimento do Pacto Global da ONU no Brasil, e a única organização de ensino superior no mundo com classificação "AA" em rating ESG, concedida pela MSCI em outubro de 2023. Isso comprova nosso comprometimento com a educação superior no país e que estamos gerando valor para todas as partes interessadas em nosso negócio.

MISSÃO

VISÃO

Transformar a educação no Brasil a partir do uso intenso de tecnologia para apoiar o desenvolvimento de jovens e adultos de todas as classes, do Oiapoque ao Chuí, com práticas sustentáveis para todos os nossos públicos.

Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

title: Manager, Overlay Cluster FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

  1. Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  2. Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  3. Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  4. Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  5. Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  6. Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  7. Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Availability to travel as needed

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Apoiar decisões estratégicas de negócio através de experimentos com rigor estatístico , tanto no online quanto no offline (agentes comerciais, polos, canais).

  • Experiência prática com A/B testing e experimentos em larga escala;
  • Fluência em Python ou R para análise estatística;

title: Moço de convés
description:
Moço de Convés

Responsabilidades

  • Executa serviços operacionais no convés de embarcações, manuseando cabos de atracação, colocando rateiras e defenas, e vigiando escadas de portaló, rampas e pranchas de embarque e desembarque. Conecta cabos de reboque vigia a embarcação, abre o porão e inspeciona quadro de chaves.
  • Carrega o rancho para bordo, comunica ao oficial de serviço, sinais luminosos avistados, ica e arria bandeiras, Baldeia convés e porão.
  • Na execução de manobras, opera equipamentos de manobra e peso, identifica anormalidades e manuseia guinchos. Opera compressores e turcos, manuseia escada de embarque e desembarque.
  • Fundeia e suspende embarcações, opera guincho de reboque, lança e resgata cabos e equipamentos. Permanece a postos com ancorote.
  • No transporte de passageiros, auxilia no embarque. Conduz passageiros às acomodações, prestando-lhes informações sobre a rota de viagem e instruções sobre os procedimentos de bordo.
  • Convoca os passageiros para desembarque e auxilia no desembarque.
  • No transporte de cargas, peia e vigia a carga. Realiza manutenção preventiva e corretiva do convés e equipamentos, confeccionando material de atracação, costurando cabos e limpando embarcações de sobrevivência, salvamento e resgate. Conserta equipamentos e realiza manutenção da pintura do convés.
  • Opera purificadores e realiza ramonagem nas caldeiras. Pode comandar ou imedia tar pequenas embarcações, conforme limites estabelecidos pelas normas da autoridade marítima. Realiza procedimentos de segurança a bordo, participando de treinamentos previstos por lei e aplicando procedimentos decorrentes do Código Internacional de Gerenciamento de Segurança.
  • Usa equipamentos de proteção individual e aplica procedimentos de primeiros socorros. Descar ta efluentes líquidos e resíduos sólidos, de acordo com normas ambientais.

OBS : Necessário CIR VIGENTE.

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Lead the process of generation and market sign-off on the most reliable forecast for all products in the market or markets under responsibility, coordinating cross-functional inputs to drive decisions on volumes based on quality data analysis. Provide visibility to improve supply and financial planning processes to optimize inventory, avoid write-offs, and improve customer service. The role is a key stakeholder for the General Manager and Leadership Team in the market(s) represented.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the process of generating an unconstrained and constrained forecast on a monthly basis (core activity in the IBP process).
  • Enable monthly validation of business performance and support decisions to achieve commercial objectives integrated with finance by identifying, analyzing, and defining actions to cover risks or gaps against the Plan.
  • Manage end-to-end demand forecasting across all brands to improve forecast accuracy and enhance customer service levels in line with external benchmarks.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver sales gap closing opportunities as required.
  • Define key forecasting roles and accountabilities across the business to align Sales, Marketing, Trade and Finance and drive a one-number mindset for decision making and forecast transparency.
  • Act as unbiased and neutral Business Partner to the General Manager and LT.
  • Establish and embed revised Demand Forecasting processes to support the Supply Chain Operating Model and Core Commercial Cycle.
  • Establish processes to support key account and trade channel-specific forecast capability to drive service levels and reduce working capital requirements.
  • Manage Demand Forecasting input into key IBP meetings (Demand Review, Supply Review, regional S&OP).
  • Identify and understand forecast changes across short- and long-term horizons to support supply chain action and informed decision making.
  • Ensure seamless handover of demand forecast and market intelligence to supply planning hubs to optimize inventory levels.
  • Integrate Trade Spend/Net Sales inputs to prioritize cost-effective net sales delivery.
  • Lead or contribute to significant projects to transform the operating model, including gross-to-net, complexity reduction, COGs, and working capital improvements.
  • Develop technical and IT capabilities to support baseline statistical modeling and integration of forecast platforms for improved accuracy.
  • Deliver long-range volume forecasts for plan submission and mid-year review.
  • Internally measure and report demand forecasting KPIs to drive improvements in forecast accuracy, bias, working capital, and customer service.
  • Provide a consolidated view of forecast trends and robustness across all Trade Channels/Categories.
  • Lead Brand/Category and Channel forecast input into Demand Review Meetings; challenge Sales/Marketing inputs to align volume and value forecasts across business units.
  • Collaborate with Category & Shopper/Sales and Marketing teams to validate NPI forecasts and assumptions.
  • Recruit and develop talent to support best-in-class forecast capability and performance.
  • Incorporate Sample and Promotional Packs inputs as required; maintain detailed knowledge of all forecast components (statistical baseline, promotions, cannibalization, market intelligence, NPI).
  • Monitor key trends impacting market, sector, and category performance.
  • Support and ensure QMS-compliant processes are in place and followed; promote a safe and compliant working environment.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Industrial Engineering, Logistics, or similar
  • At least 3 years as a demand planner or related position
  • Experience managing direct reports

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in supply chain, logistics, demand management, or related fields
  • Proactive in leading and managing information and data from the supply chain
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Leadership and influencing abilities
  • Relationship-building capability
  • Strong customer service awareness
  • Strategic and lateral thinking to deliver large-scale solutions
  • Experience with SAP and Excel; highly developed analytical skills

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It\'s a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift\'s sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift\'s legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values:

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growthrequires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
We Offer

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

Instructional Design

  • Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

To succeed in the role, you will likely bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences .

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.

  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences

Preferred

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.
Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.
Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success

description:
Join to apply for the Solutions Architect (HubSpot) role at Origin 63 | HubSpot Solutions Partner

Origin 63 is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect (HubSpot) to act as a senior technical and delivery leader across our Sales and Services teams. This role combines sales support —leading deep technical discovery, designing scalable HubSpot-centric architectures (multi-hub deployments and integrations), and scoping Statements of Work (SOWs)—with delivery ownership of select enterprise client projects.

As part of delivery, you will also serve as a technical escalation point , providing guidance when complex blockers arise and ensuring projects meet quality and timeline standards. Operating at a caliber above our Senior Strategist role, the Solutions Architect sets the technical vision for complex client engagements , bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution.

You will play a pivotal role in pre-sales engagements by delivering feasibility assessments, solution blueprints, and architecture reviews, while also providing governance and oversight during project delivery . Beyond client-facing solutioning, this role reports directly to the Director of Client Services , manages cross-departmental collaboration (Sales, Strategy, Delivery, Development) to maintain delivery excellence, and leads internal training sessions (Lunch & Learns and beyond) to elevate technical solutioning skills across the team.

This is a full-time position requiring 6 hours of regular overlap with our core collaboration hours (8 AM – 2 PM PT).

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to lead deep technical discovery sessions, capturing both business goals and technical requirements across multiple HubSpot hubs and third-party systems.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses to evaluate feasibility, risks, and trade-offs between custom development, native HubSpot capabilities, and integration options.
  • Produce detailed solution blueprints, integration maps, and architecture documentation that clearly outline system interactions, data flows, and security considerations.
  • Deliver executive-level presentations and solution demos/POCs to prospects, translating technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Sales on technical proposal content and provide pre-sales input to improve win rates, including responding to RFPs/RFIs.
  • Scope Statements of Work (SoWs) with accurate estimates, identified risks, technical assumptions, and defined success criteria.

Solution Design & In-Project Technical Discovery:

  • Validate proposed solutions with both client and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Translate business objectives into secure, scalable, and maintainable HubSpot architectures, with clear guardrails for implementation.
  • Define integration strategies (APIs, middleware, data syncs) for CRM, ERP, or marketing platforms to support seamless workflows.
  • Establish governance frameworks for data quality, user roles, and ongoing platform management.
  • Contribute to pricing and resource planning discussions by balancing feasibility, cost, and client impact.
  • Maintain a library of reusable solution patterns and documentation to improve future scoping efficiency.

Delivery Oversight & Enablement:

  • Oversee early delivery milestones to ensure alignment with the approved architecture and scopes, adjusting design where necessary based on real-world constraints.
  • Remain available as a technical escalation point during implementation to advise on blockers, integration issues, or unexpected scope changes.
  • Conduct architecture reviews at key delivery checkpoints to confirm adherence to solution design, security best practices, and client requirements.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Implementation teams to proactively identify risks and ensure project health.
  • Lead or participate in post-mortems/retrospectives, documenting lessons learned and updating best practices for future projects.
  • Report to the Director of Client Services, providing regular visibility into solution design quality, project governance, and overall delivery health.
  • Manage and align cross-departmental teams (Sales, Strategy, Delivery, Development) to ensure consistency and quality across all client engagements.
  • Lead 1–2 internal training sessions per month (Lunch & Learns and beyond) to elevate technical knowledge, solutioning practices, and team-wide competency.
  • Define, document, and enforce solutioning standards and best practices, ensuring scalable and repeatable delivery frameworks.

External Representation

  • Act as a senior technical representative of Origin 63 within the HubSpot ecosystem, engaging in sales opportunities (where HubSpot is directly involved) and representing the company at partner events.
  • Build trusted relationships with HubSpot Partner Managers, Sales representatives, and ecosystem stakeholders, demonstrating technical leadership and strategic alignment.
  • Strengthen Origin 63’s external reputation by contributing to case studies, speaking engagements, HubSpot community initiatives, and thought leadership content.

KPIs:

  • Blueprint Delivery: 100% of complex opportunities include documented solution blueprints, integration maps, and data architecture mapping, delivered in a standardized format (e.g., Miro + HubSpot/Confluence).
  • Escalation Support: 100% of escalations acknowledged within 1 business day, with ≥90% triaged and guidance provided within 2–3 business days (for assigned book of business and for projects that were scoped by you).
  • On-Time Projects: ≥90% of projects delivered within the committed timeline (≤2-week grace period).
  • Upsell Contribution: Minimum of 1–2 upsell opportunities tracked per quarter, with signed upsells expected after 90 days of onboarding.

About Topsort

Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with Multipass, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience.
Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. You can feed that VM data, just as you would on a public cloud like AWS, Azure or GCP.
The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. People sometimes use it as a build farm on a shared server, for example.
As a Software Engineer you are expected to play a leadership role designing, mentoring, reviewing and of course coding.

  • Architect new features and design the user experience
  • Write high-quality code to create new features and fix bugs
  • Review code and architecture as part of Canonical's engineering process
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Debug, track down and fix issues encountered by our users
  • Foster the open source community and support customers when needed
  • Travel internationally for up to two weeks, twice a year, for company events
What we are looking for in you
  • Cross-platform development experience on macOS and/or Windows
  • Expertise in modern C++ development
  • Experience with software testing and test-driven development
  • Extremely high personal standards for code quality, testing and design
  • Knowledge of hypervisor technologies such as Hyper-V, VirtualBox, KVM, and QEMU
  • Open source experience and involvement
  • Knowledge of CI systems a plus
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent communication skills in English - both verbal and written

Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract

At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Drive cross-product impact: Work across multiple product domains simultaneously—building experiments in Proposals, optimizing onboarding flows, and developing features that directly impact acquisition, monetization, and retention metrics
  • Move fast, responsibly: Operate in a Kanban environment where priorities shift based on experiment results and business needs, requiring you to balance rapid iteration with quality engineering practices
  • Own end-to-end user journeys: Build features that span the entire customer lifecycle—from signup and onboarding to subscription upgrades and hand-offs to implementation teams
  • Pioneer AI-driven experiences: Develop and iterate on novel AI-enhanced workflows and experiments that represent the cutting edge of roofing industry technology
  • Lead with autonomy: Work in a self-directed environment with our product designer and Growth EM, taking ownership of product decisions and driving features from conception to delivery
  • Build with experimentation in mind: Rapidly set up A/B tests and feature variations, prototype new experiences to drive user value, and help us learn and iterate on growth strategies with measurable business impact
  • Develop full-stack solutions: Build performant React components and work with Laravel backend following DDD patterns to create robust, scalable features that maintain code quality while enabling rapid experimentation
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: Know when to optimize for speed vs. complexity, always considering the unique needs of cross-domain features and growth experimentation
  • Shape the future of roofing software: Join a small, passionate team where your individual contributions directly influence product direction and company growth trajectory

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Database expertise : Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Growth engineering mindset: Experience building for experimentation and metrics-driven iteration, with a track record of breaking down complex problems into testable proofs-of-concept and rapid experiments
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with marketing, product, and design teams, consistently communicating technical tradeoffs to meet both user needs and business requirements
  • Autonomous problem-solving: You’re comfortable with ambiguity and scoping solutions independently, while knowing when to collaborate. You thrive in early-stage environments where priorities shift and individual ownership drives real impact
  • User-centered: You’ll have a deep belief that great products serve users while growing the business, with experience building accessible, reliable experiences that earn customer trust
  • A focus on quality: You value testing and documentation as much as code, and excel at making smart tradeoffs between complexity and speed to ship the right things quickly
  • Curiosity: A genuine motivation to move metrics and grow the business through thoughtful product decisions, not just technical execution

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience on a growth team or working on acquisition/monetization initiatives
  • Data-driven mindset with curiosity about user analytics and behavioural patterns
  • An eye for visuals. Design skills aren’t required, but you can think critically about existing designs
  • Experience building AI workflows in production, or the curiosity to learn
  • Experience with A/B testing tools (Google Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, etc.)

What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer paid benefits
  • Generous Parental Leave policy
  • We host 2 retreats per year and great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture
  • Weekly Friday paydays!

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as seven engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineers for these teams:
The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.
The Contracts team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that will become the single source of truth for all contracts with all customers. The service provides a standardized CPQ capability and stores signed contracts in a structured format. The service further integrates with other engineering and business systems including a CRM system and an accounting system. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in understanding sales and revenue processes and growing their skills beyond software engineering.
The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.
The Ubuntu Pro backend team designs and develops backend services for the delivery of Ubuntu Pro, the most comprehensive subscription for open-source software security. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based backend components, while the Security team at Canonical develop security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer with a strong focus on engineering quality, software performance, and reliability of operations.

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide.
